lines.text: @maya_front lifts the lid off a steaming pot in a sunny kitchen, tastes the soup from a wooden spoon and nods slowly.
Warm morning light from the left.

new_beats.text: Some mornings just taste like home.

writes.note: I kept your words and added one short VO line over the tasting.

reply.rationale: The VO adds warmth over the tasting moment without changing the action or direction, and it is short enough to fit the shot.
